scope: U5 read-only backend; not a finished UI or live-engine acceptance

transport.origin: If supplied, must equal http://127.0.0.1:<port>; bootstrap requires it.

lifecycle.start: Start a separate process and wait for readiness. Repeated starts discover the live dashboard namespace owner. A different manifest in the same workspace is a conflict.
lifecycle.status: Query the live namespace owner, then verify the service-specific control endpoint and private discovery identity; never trust a stored port or PID alone.
lifecycle.stop: Target the exact service_id using a separate private service capability; browser cookies cannot stop the service or mutate a workflow.
lifecycle.access: Only an explicit interactive terminal displays a one-use code. Machine output contains the URL and instructions, never a code.
lifecycle.ownership: Use the dashboard namespace only. Never project outbox, write canonical state, start a controller, or launch workers.

authentication.bootstrap: POST /api/bootstrap with application/json {"code":"<locally entered one-use code>"}; success 204 with HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/ cookie.
authentication.rotation: Codes and sessions are memory-only and invalidated on restart. Codes are single-use. No credential belongs in a URL.
authentication.session: GET /api/session returns {schema_version:1,service_id,expires_at,read_only:true}; unauthenticated or expired sessions return 401.
authentication.browser_flow: Serve the static login UI without a cookie. Submit the entered code with a same-origin POST, then fetch snapshot and open one EventSource per page. On 401/auth_expired, close EventSource and show the access flow.

routes.GET /: Allowlisted dashboard/index.html only; 503 UI_UNAVAILABLE until frontend integration.
routes.GET /api/snapshot?run_id=<optional>: Authenticated. {schema_version:1,service_id,snapshot:<unchanged U4 snapshot>,stream:{run_id,after:null},controller_service:{status,observed_at,service_id}}. Omitted run_id follows the current run.
routes.GET /api/events?run_id=<required>&after=: Authenticated bounded U4 readEvents page, plus schema_version and service_id. Resume from cursor, not latest_cursor. Malformed cursor strings still use U4 reset_required semantics.
routes.GET /api/stream?run_id=<required>&after=: Authenticated SSE. Last-Event-ID overrides after on reconnect. Fixed selected run; observation.current_run_id lets a current-run view detect rerun and switch intentionally.
routes.GET /api/artifact?run_id=<required>&phas: Authenticated JSON containing identity, kind, content (untrusted UTF-8 text), sha256, accepted_sha256, matches_accepted. Kinds: completion, heartbeat, verdict, checkpoint, release. Resolve from the selected snapshot's allowlisted attempt paths; no arbitrary file/path parameter or prompt access.

sse.observation: No id field. data: {schema_version:1,service_id,run_id,current_run_id,revision,event_cursor,updated_at,reader_observed_at,controller,controller_service,projection,history}. Sent once per second even without state changes. Refresh canonical snapshot on revision/current-run changes; use observation timestamps for freshness.
sse.events: id is the last actually delivered event_id. data is the bounded events-page envelope. Events are timeline/refresh notifications, never instructions or progress reducers. Deduplicate timeline items by run_id + event_id, including across reconnect/reset.
sse.reset: Empty id field clears EventSource Last-Event-ID. data: {schema_version:1,service_id,run_id,reset_required:true,resume_after:null,latest_cursor,history}. Fetch a fresh snapshot, keep its canonical progress, and resume projected history from null. Server retries bounded history reads; gaps remain visible.
sse.error: No id field. Same error envelope as HTTP. STATE_UNAVAILABLE is recoverable on the next observation. AUTH_EXPIRED closes the stream and requires a new access flow.
sse.cursor_rule: snapshot.event_cursor and events.latest_cursor mean latest committed, possibly still pending projection. Neither is a delivered log cursor. snapshot.stream.after is intentionally null. If a client passes a snapshot cursor ahead of projection, reset + replay of available timeline IDs must not roll back or double-apply canonical progress.
sse.backpressure: Slow clients are disconnected rather than queued without bounds. Reconnect uses only the last received event_id.

errors.redaction: Fixed diagnostic messages only. Do not return raw canonical state, prompts, capabilities, stack traces, or filesystem exceptions.

freshness.reader_observed_at: Last successful companion snapshot read; never advances on read failure.
freshness.controller: The U4 run-bound observation. Workspace readiness alone cannot prove that a controller is monitoring this run, so it never fabricates running status. Confirmed absence can mark the current run stopped; historical run status remains unknown.
freshness.controller_service: Separate async workspace owner readiness observation: running, stopped, or unavailable. Includes observed_at and service_id; this is not worker liveness or run-correlated controller health.
freshness.polling: Permanent one-second read-only observation independent of controller progress and U6.

frontend_integration.rendering: Use textContent for all worker content. Do not use innerHTML for artifact content or events. CSP forbids inline script, eval, framing, and external connections.
frontend_integration.release: Coordinator must explicitly agree to this contract and release frontend work. Contract publication alone is not release.
coordinator_requests: Add dashboard-server.test.js to the maintained scripts npm test list, preserving event-log.test.js/read-model.test.js and adapter additions.
Wire dashboard lifecycle/access usage into coordinator-owned README and skill prose.
Run combined browser acceptance, including authentication, reconnect, truthful completion labels, accessibility, and safe artifact display.
